chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may Allah have mercy on him) said: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umair, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam, who said: I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): What is the proof that Allah is One?

He (peace be upon him) replied: The continuity of management and the perfection of creation, as the Mighty and Majestic said: 'If there had been in them gods other than Allah, they would both have been in disorder.'

key_terms.لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَا آلِهَةٌ إِلَّا اللَّ: If there had been in them gods other than Allah, they would both have been in disorder

ai.seo_question: What is the theological proof for Allah's Oneness based on the continuity of creation?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration in *al-Tawhid*, highlighting the rational argument of *ittisal al-tadbir* (continuity of governance) as a primary proof for Tawhid. The Imam (AS) links the perfection of creation to the necessity of a single, undivided Divine Manager, citing the Quranic verse to demonstrate that multiple deities would inevitably lead to cosmic disorder and corruption.

en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 2. Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (RA) said: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan alSaffar said, on the authority of Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn `Isa, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Abu `Umayr, on the authority of Hisham ibn al-Hakam that I asked Abu `Abd Allah al-Sadiq (AS): “What is the Proof that Allah is One?”

He (AS) replied, “The Proof that Allah is One can be seen in the continued management of creation and its perfection in all aspects. As the Mighty and High says: If there had been in them any gods except Allah, they would both have certainly been in a state of disorder.”
